extraction.Name: Albert Whipple
extraction.NOTES: Agency narrative cover letter from E.E. McKean, Superintendent, Rosebud, South Dakota, dated July 5, 1929, transmitting affidavit of Albert Whipple to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs; fee patent issued without request of patentee; Whipple made a cash sale originally for his land but later purchased it back; complaint made after repurchase; superintendent's opinion is that a judgment against either of the parties Whipple mentions would be worthless; affidavit added to report of similar cases made on June 22nd; file reference 6-1142
